text:
Male patients are usually asked to bring their own electric razor because hospitals often don't supply razors, and an electric razor is less likely than a disposable blade to nick the skin and raise infection risk. The team note's cross-infection explanation is plausible, but I haven't seen it stated as the main reason, and I haven't checked any particular hospital's policy. Before surgery, staff may ask you not to shave at all, because clipping is generally preferred.

CONFIDENCE: 65
